stages.title: Backlog refinement
stages.does: Run the INVEST check and fix the flagged stories with the product owner's intent.

stages.title: Product owner reviews the backlog
stages.does: The product owner approves the refined backlog or asks for changes.

stages.title: Sprint planning
stages.does: Pick stories under the team's capacity, in priority order.

stages.title: Implement one story
stages.does: The developer implements the current story as a change set.

stages.title: Code review
stages.does: The reviewer checks the change set against the definition of done.

stages.title: Product owner acceptance
stages.does: The product owner accepts or rejects the story against its acceptance criteria.

stages.title: Next story
stages.does: Move to the next story or end the sprint's work.

stages.title: Carry the story over
stages.does: Move the story back to the backlog with the reason.

stages.title: Retrospective
stages.does: What to change next sprint, based on the loops that happened.

stages.title: Another sprint or release
stages.does: The product owner decides whether to plan another sprint or release.

stages.title: Release notes
stages.does: Write the release notes from the accepted stories.
